thread:
maria: heads up — deploy-bot aborted the publish to eu-west-2 and ap-northeast-1. it accepted the image in us-east-1 but we have a fingerprint gap for the mirrored manifests. saw partial index pushed in ap-northeast-1. should we pin and roll back or retry publish?

deploy-bot: Automated check failed: manifest index mismatch across regions (fingerprint mismatch). attempted retries: 3. action: HOLD. See /logs/deploy/2155550123.
devon: can you paste the `skopeo inspect` output from the ap-northeast-1 repo? want to see which manifest entry is missing platform info.
maria: grabbing it now, one sec.
jess: if it's just a missing platform entry we could retag the us-east artifact into ap-northeast and force push the full manifest index, but that violates our immutability guard unless we do a short maintenance window.
kai: change window is 16:00-17:00 UTC, ops is available then. but can we avoid a window by doing a canary fallback to us-east? routing might add latency for EU customers.
devon: skopeo output: ```json
{"Name":"redwood-registry/eval-service:2026.03","ManifestList":true,"Manifests":[{"MediaType":"application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json","Platform":{"architecture":"amd64","os":"linux"},"Digest":"sha256:aaa..."}]}
```
notice ap-northeast manifest index missing arm64 entry, but our build published arm64 simultaneously. looks like mirror job dropped a layer.
maria: ok — options: 1) pin release to us-east-only tag and update release notes, 2) run a targeted republish of the missing manifest entry into ap-northeast (requires temp allowlist), 3) wait for mirror job to re-run (unknown ETA). input?
jess: I prefer (2) — targeted republish plus short allowlist change. ops can toggle immutability for the single repo for 10m. we keep digest stable.
kai: ops agrees to a 10m exception in change window if we coordinate. but that still needs a rollout note & customer-facing risk blurb.
devon: republish command I used in staging: ```bash
oci-push --manifest-list src-us-east:sha256:aaa... --target-registry ap-northeast-1.redwood.internal/eval-service
```
if we do that, we should also kick a mirror job and verify `skopeo inspect` shows arm64 present.
maria: jess, can you own the allowlist request? devon, you run the republish after ops flips the toggle. i'll prepare a short rollback plan in case the mirror ends up with conflicting manifests (retag to prev digest and halt canary).
jess: will request allowlist now — pinging @ops. submitting ticket with urgency=high and window=10m.
deploy-bot: NOTE: if republish completes, deploy-bot will revalidate cross-region fingerprints and automatically unhold if checks pass. Manual unhold allowed via `/deploybot unhold 2155550123` by lead-eng.
kai: ops ticket ACKed. target window 16:05 UTC. releasing a short release note: "Hotfix: regional manifest sync — temporary republish to repair missing platform entry in ap-northeast-1. No user-visible changes expected; routing may fallback to us-east for a small subset of traffic during the fix."
maria: thanks. devon, wait for ops confirmation then run the republish. jess please add the rollback steps in the ticket. i'll post final notice here when unhold happens. :thumbsup:
